scope: A1-A3 (product stage, cradle to gate); biogenic carbon in timber not subtracted
source: Illustrative values of the size an EPD (Environmental Product Declaration) database lists for generic products, such as the ICE inventory or EC3; not taken from any one EPD and not for a real assessment.
matching: Families are tried in the order listed. An element takes the first family whose keyword appears as a whole word in its type name; failing that, in its material names in layer order, skipping cavity layers (air spaces and stud layers, which are mostly void). An element that matches no family has no factor.
